components.name: pyrowave
components.description: GPU wavelet codec, vendored at crates/pyrowave-sys/vendor/pyrowave (pruned tree) with local patches from crates/pyrowave-sys/patches/; commits recorded in vendor/pyrowave/PUNKTFUNK-VENDOR.txt

components.name: Granite
components.description: Vulkan backend subset vendored inside the pyrowave tree

components.name: volk
components.description: Vulkan meta-loader vendored inside the pyrowave/Granite tree

components.name: Vulkan-Headers
components.description: Vulkan API headers vendored inside the pyrowave tree

components.name: libvpl
components.description: Intel oneVPL dispatcher, vendored at crates/libvpl-sys/vendor/libvpl

components.name: fec-rs
components.description: Reed-Solomon FEC, forked at crates/punktfunk-core/vendor/fec-rs with the Cauchy generator matrix Moonlight's nanors uses

components.name: cros-codecs
components.description: H.264/H.265/AV1/VP9 parser layer, vendored at crates/pf-bitstream/vendor/cros-codecs with the deviations in its PROVENANCE.md

components.name: usbip
components.description: USB/IP server simulation, vendored and trimmed as usbip-sim at crates/pf-inject/vendor/usbip-sim; changes listed in its NOTICE

components.name: ndk

components.description: WDK build-script support, vendored at packaging/windows/drivers/vendor/wdk-build via [patch.crates-io]
